jobs.title: Primary Spanish Editor
jobs.reason: This role requires native-level Spanish (editing Spanish-language educational textbooks with mastery of Spanish grammar and ortho-typographic norms), which the candidate does not have — a hard language disqualifier. It also requires three years of textbook editing experience, exceeding the candidate's RA-level background, and sits entirely outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for expert advisory-committee members, not a paid staff role — it seeks established experts with regional activist/practitioner experience and reads as an unpaid/speculative advisory position rather than a genuine entry-level paid vacancy. The human-rights/securitisation topic is interesting, but the committee is aimed at senior experts, not an early-career candidate.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Enterprise Applications
jobs.reason: A "Manager"-level role requiring 3–6 years of demonstrable technical project-management experience and Scrum Master / ServiceNow / enterprise-integration expertise the candidate does not have — both a level and a deep-technical disqualifier. Although a London option exists, the essential experience and technical requirements are far beyond an early-career research profile.
